node.name: Guard: CLP and PLB counts
node.logic: CLPCount = count of 2000 (LX) loops. PLBCount = count of PLB segments. Continue only if (CLPCount == 1) or (PLBCount == 0). Else write one failed ImportLog: 'There were {CLP} CLP payments and {PLB} PLB adjustments on transaction {ST02}' and post nothing.
